title: OEM quotations
intro: Open the customer’s OEM request file, or enter a request from an email or message. Add your prices to prepare the offer.
local: Your entries stay in this tab. Download a copy before closing it.
noscript: Enable JavaScript to calculate and create the quotation in your browser.
name: Contact name
docHint: Document headings follow this language. Write your descriptions and terms in the customer’s language.
itemsHint: Enter unit prices in baht. Add a line for design, samples or delivery if needed.
sendHint: Save a PDF and attach it to your email or send it through the customer’s chosen channel.
revisionHint: Start a new revision before changing an offer already sent. The current offer and its prices will be kept in the history.
newRev: Keep this version and start the next
dateError: Check the dates. The valid-through date must be on or after the issue date.
priceError: Check quantities, unit prices and discount. Quantities must exceed zero and discount cannot exceed subtotal.
headerError: Enter a quotation number and a customer or company name before issuing the offer.
invalidFile: Could not open this file. Select an OEM request or editable quotation JSON downloaded from this website.
replace: Opening this file will replace the work in this tab. Continue?
max: This file has reached the maximum number of items or revisions.
newDone: Previous version kept. You are editing a new revision.
draftBody: Please find our OEM quotation attached.
